ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Meeem
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Meem

ayahs.ar: اَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ اَنۡ يُّتۡرَكُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ahasiban naasu anyu yutrakooo any yaqoolooo aamannaa wa hum la yuftanoon
ayahs.en: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ صَدَقُوۡا وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad fatannal lazeena min qablihim fala ya'lamannal laahul lazeena sadaqoo wa la ya'lamannal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ يَّسۡبِقُوۡنَاؕ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am hasibal lazeena ya'maloonas sayyiaati any yasbiqoonaa; saaa'a maa yahkumoon
ayahs.en: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوۡا لِقَآءَ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ لَاٰتٍؕ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Man kaana yarjoo liqaaa 'allaahi fa inna ajalal laahi laaat; wa Huwass Sameeul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ جٰهَدَ فَاِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهٖؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa man jaahada fainnamaa yujaahidu linafsih; innal laaha laghaniyyun 'anil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ اَحۡسَنَ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lanukaf firanna 'anhum saiyiaatihim wa lanajziyannahum ahsanal lazee kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: وَوَصَّيۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ بِوَالِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنًاؕ وَاِنۡ جٰهَدٰكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِيۡ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَاؕ اِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَاُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa wassainal insaana biwaalidaihi husnanw wa in jaahadaaka litushrika bee maa laisa laka bihee 'ilmun falaa tuti'humaa; ilaiya marji'ukum fa unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati lanudkhilan nahum fis saaliheen
ayahs.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ فَاِذَا٘ اُوۡذِيَ فِي اللّٰهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللّٰهِؕ وَلَئِنۡ جَآءَ نَصۡرٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡؕ اَوَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa minan naasi many yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi faizaaa ooziya fil laahi ja'ala fitnatan naasi ka'azaabil laahi wa la'in jaaa'a nasrum mir Rabbika la yaqoolunna innaa kunnaa ma'akum; awa laisal laahu bi a'lama bimaa fee surdooril 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

ayahs.ar: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ الۡمُنٰفِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa la ya'lamannal laahul lazeena aamanoo wa la ya'lamannal munaafiqeen
ayahs.en: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوۡا سَبِيۡلَنَا وَلۡنَحۡمِلۡ خَطٰيٰكُمۡؕ وَمَا هُمۡ بِحٰمِلِيۡنَ مِنۡ خَطٰيٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّهُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazaeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanut tabi'oo sabeelanaa walnahmil khataayaakum wa maa hum bihaamileena min khataa yaahum min shai'in innahum lakaaziboon
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.

ayahs.ar: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ اَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَاَثۡقَالًا مَّعَ اَثۡقَالِهِمۡؗ وَلَيُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la yahmilunna asqaa lahum wa asqaalam ma'a asqaalihim wa la yus'alunna Yawmal Qiyaamati 'ammaa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ فَلَبِثَ فِيۡهِمۡ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ اِلَّا خَمۡسِيۡنَ عَامًاؕ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوۡفَانُ وَهُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee falabisa feehim alfa sanatin illaa khamseena 'aaman fa akhazahumut toofaanu wa hum zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَصۡحٰبَ السَّفِيۡنَةِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa anjainaahu wa as haabas safeenati wa ja'alnaahaaa Aayatal lil'aalameen
ayahs.en: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَاِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُؕ ذٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Ibraheema iz qaala liqawmihi' budul laaha wattaqoohu zaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡثَانًا وَّتَخۡلُقُوۡنَ اِفۡكًاؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لَكُمۡ رِزۡقًا فَابۡتَغُوۡا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ الرِّزۡقَ وَاعۡبُدُوۡهُ وَاشۡكُرُوۡا لَهٗؕ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa ta'ubdoona min doonil laahi awsaananw-wa takhluqoona ifkaa; innal lazeena ta'budoona min doonil laahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqan fabtaghoo 'indal laahir rizqa fabtaghoo 'indal laahir rizqa wa'budoohu washkuroo lahooo ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: You only worship, besides Allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ تُكَذِّبُوۡا فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اُمَمٌ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡؕ وَمَا عَلَي الرَّسُوۡلِ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Wa in tukazziboo faqad kazzaba umamum min qablikum wa maa'alar Rasooli illal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.en: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ يُبۡدِئُ اللّٰهُ الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ يَسِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Awa lam yaraw kaifa yubdi'ul laahul khalqa summa yu'eeduh; inna zaalika 'alal laahi yaseer
ayahs.en: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah, is easy.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ بَدَاَ الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ اللّٰهُ يُنۡشِئُ النَّشۡاَةَ الۡاٰخِرَةَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul seeroo fil ardi fanzuroo kaifa baa al khalqa summal laahu yunshi''un nash atal Aakhirah; innal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allah will produce the final creation. Indeed Allah, over all things, is competent."

ayahs.ar: يُعَذِّبُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yu'azzibu many yashaaa'u wa yarhamu many yashaaa'; wa ilaihi tuqlaboon
ayahs.en: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِؗ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa antum bimu'jizeena fil ardi wa laa fissamaaa'i wa maa lakum min doonil laahi minw waliyyinw wa laa naseer
ayahs.en: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَلِقَآئِهٖ٘ اُولٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوۡا مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِيۡ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kafaroo bi Aayaatil laahi wa liqaaa'iheee ulaaa'ika ya'isoo mir rahmatee wa ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوا اقۡتُلُوۡهُ اَوۡ حَرِّقُوۡهُ فَاَنۡجٰىهُ اللّٰهُ مِنَ النَّارِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmiheee illaaa an qaaluqtuloohu aw harriqoohu faanjaahul laahu minan naar; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil laqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ اِنَّمَا اتَّخَذۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡثَانًاۙ مَّوَدَّةَ بَيۡنِكُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ بِبَعۡضٍ وَّيَلۡعَنُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ بَعۡضًاؗ وَّمَاۡوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَࣗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala innamat takhaz tum min doonil laahi awsaanam mawaddata bainikum fil hayaatid dunyaa summa yawmal qiyaamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba 'dinw wa yal'anu ba'dukum ba'danw-wa yal'anu ba'dukum ba'danw wa maa waakumun Naaru wa maa lakum min naasireen
ayahs.en: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

ayahs.ar: فَاٰمَنَ لَهٗ لُوۡطٌۘ وَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ مُهَاجِرٌ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Fa aamana lahoo Loot; wa qaala innee mauhajirun ilaa Rabbee innahoo Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالۡكِتٰبَ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ اَجۡرَهٗ فِي الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَاِنَّهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa wahabnaa lahoo Ishaaqa wa Ya'Qooba wa ja'alnaa fee zurriyyatihin Nubuwwata wal Kitaaba wa aatainaahu ajrahoo fid dunyaa wa innahoo fil aakhirati laminas saaliheen
ayahs.en: And We gave to Him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡفَاحِشَةَؗ مَا سَبَقَكُمۡ بِهَا مِنۡ اَحَدٍ مِّنَ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Lootan iz qaala liqawmiheee innakum laatoonal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadim minal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُوۡنَ السَّبِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ وَتَاۡتُوۡنَ فِيۡ نَادِيۡكُمُ الۡمُنۡكَرَؕ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوا ائۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: A'innakum lataatoonar rijaala wa taqta'oonas sabeela wa taatoona fee naadekumul munkara famaa kaana jawaaba qawmiheee illaaa an qaalu' tinaaa bi'azaabil laahi in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ انۡصُرۡنِيۡ عَلَي الۡقَوۡمِ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbin surnee 'alal qawmil mufsideen
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ بِالۡبُشۡرٰيۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلِ هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةِۚ اِنَّ اَهۡلَهَا كَانُوۡا ظٰلِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'at Rusulunaaa Ibraaheema bil bushraa qaalooo innaa muhlikoo ahli haazihil qaryati inna ahlahaa kaanoo zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that Lot's city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ فِيۡهَا لُوۡطًاؕ قَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ فِيۡهَاؗ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهٗ وَاَهۡلَهٗ٘ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗؗ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala inna feeha Lootaa; qaaloo nahnu a'lamu biman feehaa lanunajjjiyannahoo wa ahlahooo illam ra atahoo kaanat minal ghaabireen
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا٘ اَنۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوۡطًا سِيۡٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعًا وَّقَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡࣞ اِنَّا مُنَجُّوۡكَ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaaa an jaaa'at Rusulunaa Lootan seee'a bihim wa daaqa bihim zar'anw wa qaaloo laa takhaf wa laa tahzan innaa munajjooka wa ahlaka illam ra ataka kaanat minal ghaabireen
ayahs.en: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا مُنۡزِلُوۡنَ عَلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِ هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡسُقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaa munziloona 'alaaa ahli haazihil qaryati rijzam minas samaaa'i bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَا٘ اٰيَةًۭ بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqat taraknaa min haaa aayatam baiyinatal liqawminy ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.

ayahs.ar: وَاِلٰي مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًاۙ فَقَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَارۡجُوا الۡيَوۡمَ الۡاٰخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ilaa Madyana akhaahum Shu'ayban faqaala yaa qawmi'-budul laaha warjul yawmal aakhira wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
ayahs.en: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الرَّجۡفَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazat humur rajfatu fa asbahoo fee daarihim jaasimeen
ayahs.en: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

ayahs.ar: وَعَادًا وَّثَمُوۡدَا۠ وَقَدۡ تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّسٰكِنِهِمۡࣟ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡتَبۡصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa 'Aadanw wa Samooda wa qat tabaiyana lakum mim masaakinihim wa zaiyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis sabeeli wa kaanoo mustabsireen
ayahs.en: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.

ayahs.ar: وَقَارُوۡنَ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَࣞ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانُوۡا سٰبِقِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Qaaroona wa Fir'awna wa haamaana wa laqad jaaa'ahum Moosa bilbaiyinaati fastakbaroo fil ardi wa maa kaanoo saabiqeen
ayahs.en: And [We destroyed] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].

ayahs.ar: فَكُلًّا اَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۭۡ بِهٖۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبًاۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَخَذَتۡهُ الصَّيۡحَةُۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakullan akhaznaa bizam bihee faminhum man arsalnaa 'alaihi haasibaa; wa minhum man akhazat hus saihatu wa minhum man khasafnaa bihil arda wa minhum man aghraqnaa; wa maa kaanal laahu li yazlimahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.

ayahs.ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ الۡعَنۡكَبُوۡتِۚ اِتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتًاؕ وَاِنَّ اَوۡهَنَ الۡبُيُوۡتِ لَبَيۡتُ الۡعَنۡكَبُوۡتِۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Masalul lazeenat takhazoo min doonil laahi awliyaaa'a kamasalil 'ankaboot, ittakhazat baitaa; wa inna awhanal buyooti la baitul 'ankaboot; law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha ya'lamu maa yad'oona min doonihee min shai'; wa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡاَمۡثَالُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِۚ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَا٘ اِلَّا الۡعٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa tilkal amsaalu nadribuhaa linnaasi wa maa ya'qiluhaaa illal 'aalimoon
ayahs.en: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Khalaqal laahus samaawaati wal arda bilhaqq; inna fee zaalika la aayatal lilmu mineen
ayahs.en: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

ayahs.ar: اُتۡلُ مَا٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنَ الۡكِتٰبِ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَؕ اِنَّ الصَّلٰوةَ تَنۡهٰي عَنِ الۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَالۡمُنۡكَرِؕ وَلَذِكۡرُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Utlu maaa oohiya ilaika mional Kitaabi wa aqimis Salaata innas Salaata tanhaa 'anil fahshaaa'i wal munkar; wa lazikrul laahi akbar; wal laahu ya'lamu maa tasna'oon
ayahs.en: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُؗ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ وَقُوۡلُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡنَا وَاُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ وَاِلٰهُنَا وَاِلٰهُكُمۡ وَاحِدٌ وَّنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tujaadilooo Ahlal Kitaabi illaa billatee hiya ahsanu illal lazeena zalamoo minhum wa qoolooo aamannaa billazeee unzila ilainaa wa unzila ilaikum wa illaahunna wa illahukum waahidunw-wa nahnu lahoo muslimoon
ayahs.en: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖۚ وَمِنۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِهٖؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلَّا الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika anzalnaaa ilaikal Kitaab; fallazeena aatainaahumul kitaaba yu'minoona bihee wa min haaa'ulaaa'i many yu'minu bih; wa maa yajhadu bi'Aayaatinaa illal kaafiroon
ayahs.en: And thus We have sent down to you the Qur'an. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتَ تَتۡلُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مِنۡ كِتٰبٍ وَّلَا تَخُطُّهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ اِذًا لَّارۡتَابَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kunta tatloo min qablihee min kitaabinw wa laa takhuttubhoo bi yameenika izal lartaabal mubtiloon
ayahs.en: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Otherwise the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ هُوَ اٰيٰتٌۭ بَيِّنٰتٌ فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَؕ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلَّا الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal huwa aayaatum baiyinaatun fee sudooril lazeena ootul 'ilm; wa maa yajhadu bi aayaatinaa illaz zaalimoon
ayahs.en: Rather, the Qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡاٰيٰتُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo law laaa unzila 'alaihi aayaatum mir Rabbihee qul innamal aayaatu 'indal laahi wa innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ اَنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ يُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةً وَّذِكۡرٰي لِقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Awa lam yakfihim annaaa anzalnaa 'alaikal kitaaba yutlaa 'alaikhim; inna fee zaalika larahmatanw wa zikraa liqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ كَفٰي بِاللّٰهِ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيۡدًاۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوۡا بِاللّٰهِۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul kafaa billaahi bainee wa bainakum shaheedaa; ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wal ard; wallazeena aamanoo bil baatili wa kafaroo billaahi ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon
ayahs.en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers."

ayahs.ar: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِؕ وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّي لَّجَآءَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ وَلَيَاۡتِيَنَّهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yasta'jiloonaka bil'azaab; wa law laaa ajalum musammal lajaaa'ahumul 'zaab; wa la yaatiyannahum baghta tanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.

ayahs.ar: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَكَ بِالۡعَذَابِؕ وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيۡطَةٌۭ بِالۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yasta'jiloonak bil'azaab; wa inna Jahannama lamuhee tatum bilkaafireen
ayahs.en: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشٰىهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِنۡ تَحۡتِ اَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma yaghshaahumul 'azaabu min fawqihim wa min tahti arjulim wa yaqoolu zooqoo maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ اَرۡضِيۡ وَاسِعَةٌ فَاِيَّايَ فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Yaa 'ibaadiyal lazeena aamanooo inna ardee waasi 'atun fa iyyaaya fa'budoon
ayahs.en: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.

ayahs.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِࣞ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kullu nafsin zaaa'iqatul mawti summa ilainaa turja'oon
ayahs.en: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ نِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَࣗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati la nubawwi 'annahum minal Jannati ghurafan tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; ni'ma ajrul 'aamileen
ayahs.en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena sabaroo wa 'alaa Rabbihim yatawakkaloon
ayahs.en: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.

ayahs.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَاؗࣗۖ اَللّٰهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَاِيَّاكُمۡؗۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa ka ayyim min daaabbatil laa tahmilu riqqahaa; al laahu yarzuquhaa wa iyyaakum; wa Huwas Samee'ul Aleem
ayahs.en: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُۚ فَاَنّٰي يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal arda wa sakhkharash shamsa wal qamara la yaqoolunnal laahu fa ann yu'fakoon
ayahs.en: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allah." Then how are they deluded?

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهٗؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Allaahu yabsutur rizqa limany yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee wa yaqdiru lah; innal laaha bikulli shai'in Aleem
ayahs.en: Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ نَّزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِهَا لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُؕ قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in sa altahum man nazzala minas samaaa'e maaa'an fa ahyaa bihil arda mim ba'di mawtihaa la yaqoolunnal laah; qulil hamdu lillah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say " Allah." Say, "Praise to Allah "; but most of them do not reason.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا٘ اِلَّا لَهۡوٌ وَّلَعِبٌؕ وَاِنَّ الدَّارَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الۡحَيَوَانُۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa haazihil hayaa tud dunyaaa illaa lahwunw-wa la'ib; wa innad Daaral Aakhirata la hiyal ha yawaan; law kaano ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا رَكِبُوۡا فِي الۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۚ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰىهُمۡ اِلَي الۡبَرِّ اِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa-izaa rakiboo fil fulki da'awul laaha mukhilseena lahud deena falammaa najjaa hum ilal baari izaa hum yushrikoon
ayahs.en: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

ayahs.ar: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡۚۙ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوۡاࣟ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Li yakfuroo bimaaa aatainaahum wa li yatamatta'oo fasaw fa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَّيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡؕ اَفَبِالۡبَاطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yaraw annaa ja'alnaa haraman aaminanw wa yutakhattafun naasu min haw lihim; afabil baatili yu'minoona wa bini'matil laahi yakfuroon
ayahs.en: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِالۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهٗؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوًي لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa man azlamu mimma nif taraa 'alal laahi kaziban aw kazzaba bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ah; alaisa fee jahannama maswal lil kaafireen
ayahs.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ جٰهَدُوۡا فِيۡنَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَمَعَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena jaahadoo feenaa lanahdiyannahum subulana; wa innal laaha lama'al muhsineen
ayahs.en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
